aws_access_key_id.description: The unique access key ID of the S3 bucket you want to use to stage your data. Use this parameter only if you are using Hybrid Deployment.

aws_secret_access_key.description: The secret access key of the S3 bucket you want to use to stage your data. Use this parameter only if you are using Hybrid Deployment.

bucket.description: The name of the storage bucket you want to use to stage your data. Use this parameter only if you are using Hybrid Deployment.

bucket_region.description: The AWS Region of the S3 bucket you want to use to stage your data. Use this parameter only if you are using Hybrid Deployment.

cluster_id.description: Cluster ID. Must be populated if `connection_type` is set to `SshTunnel` and `auth_type` is set to `IAM`.

cluster_region.description: Cluster region. Must be populated if `connection_type` is set to `SshTunnel` and `auth_type` is set to `IAM`.

enable_super_type.description: Enable to convert JSON data type to SUPER

password.description: Database user password. Required if authentication type is `PASSWORD`.

role_arn.description: Role ARN with Redshift permissions. Required if authentication type is `IAM`.

s3_bucket_auth_type.description: Type of authentication configured for the S3 bucket you want to use to stage your data. Use this parameter only if you are using Hybrid Deployment

tunnel_host.description: SSH server name. Must be populated if `connection_type` is set to `SshTunnel`.

tunnel_port.description: SSH server port name. Must be populated if `connection_type` is set to `SshTunnel`.

tunnel_user.description: SSH user name. Must be populated if `connection_type` is set to `SshTunnel`.

password.description: ESM key for database user password

user.description: ESM key for database user name
